info.title: My Little Big Project Planner API
info.description:
REST API of My Little Big Project Planner. The web interface uses this same API.

**Conventions**

- Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`, listed in the `ErrorCode` schema.
- Updates and deletions require `If-Match` with the resource's `ETag` (428 without it, 412 when the resource changed).
- Creations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header: replaying the request does not create a duplicate.
- Lists are paginated with an opaque cursor (`limit`, `cursor`, `nextCursor`).
- `?fields=` selects the returned fields.
- Translated labels follow `Accept-Language`, then the tenant's default language.

**Authentication**

Endpoints need a session unless stated otherwise: sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in`, which sets the `mlbpp_session` cookie. Every state-changing request (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) must also send the session's CSRF token in the `X-CSRF-Token` header (403 `csrf.invalid` otherwise); it is in the `mlbpp_csrf` cookie and in `GET /api/v1/auth/session`.

get.summary: My two-step verification

post.summary: Enable two-step verification with a first code
post.description: A code from the app proves it holds the secret. Answers 8 backup codes, shown this once. A session waiting for this enrollment becomes complete (new cookies).

post.summary: Disable two-step verification
post.description: Confirmed by a code from the app or a backup code. Refused when the organization requires two-step verification.

204.description: Disabled: secret and backup codes deleted

post.summary: Start enabling two-step verification
post.description: Draws a new secret, shown as a QR code and as text. It is only enabled once `POST /account/mfa/confirm` receives a code from the app. Starting again replaces the secret.

200.description: The secret to add to the authenticator app

post.summary: Show an invitation to its invitee
post.description: With the token of the invitation link (in the body, so that it is never logged). For the invitation page.

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

post.summary: Accept an invitation
post.description: Joins the tenant with the account of the invitation's email, created with `displayName` and `password` when there is none. An internal member is then signed in under the tenant's policy (two-step verification, SSO). The link works once.

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

get.summary: Come back from the identity provider
get.description: A browser navigation, the redirect URI registered at the provider. The state must be one this API issued for this tenant, unused and less than 10 minutes old; the ID token is checked (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce). Its verified email must be an active internal member's: a session opens (cookies) and the browser goes to the page it came from. Otherwise, to the sign-in page with `?error=auth.oidc_failed`, `auth.oidc_no_member` or `auth.oidc_email_unverified`.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the provider when the user cancelled or it failed.

303.description: Into the application, or back to the sign-in page

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

get.summary: Leave for the identity provider
get.description: A browser navigation: redirects to the provider, with state, nonce and PKCE. On error, redirects to the sign-in page with `?error=<code>`.

parameters.name: returnUrl
parameters.description: Page of the application to show once signed in (a path).

303.description: To the provider, or back to the sign-in page

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

post.summary: Email a password reset link
post.description: Always 202, whether the email has an account or not. A member of the tenant receives a link valid for one hour.

202.description: Accepted: an email is sent if the account exists

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

post.summary: Choose a new password with a reset link
post.description: Sets the new password and ends every session of the account. The link works once.

400.description: `auth.reset_token_invalid`, or the password is too short, too long or equal to the email (`validation_failed`)

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

get.summary: Identity providers of the sign-in page
get.description: The enabled OIDC providers of the tenant, for the sign-in buttons. A button leads the browser to `/api/v1/auth/oidc/{id}/start`.

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

get.summary: The current session
get.description: The signed-in member, the CSRF token and the session's `stage` (a session waiting for two-step verification included), or 401.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Opens a session in the tenant of the request's host: sets the `mlbpp_session` (HttpOnly) and `mlbpp_csrf` cookies. After 5 failures on one email, or many from one address, sign-in is refused for 15 minutes (429). The error never tells whether the email has an account.

When two-step verification is on, or required by the tenant, the session's `stage` is `mfa_challenge` or `mfa_enrollment`: it reaches nothing but the next step, for 5 or 15 minutes.

403.description: `auth.sso_required`: the organization signs this member in through its identity provider

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

post.summary: Complete sign-in with a two-step verification code
post.description: For a session at the `mfa_challenge` stage: a code from the authenticator app, or a backup code, which then cannot be used again. Opens a complete session (new cookies). After 5 wrong codes, the account is blocked 15 minutes (429).

409.description: `conflict`: the session is not waiting for a code

post.summary: Sign out
post.description: Ends the session: its cookie no longer works, even if replayed.

204.description: Signed out; the cookies are cleared

get.summary: Arrive in another tenant
get.description: A browser navigation, to the link of `POST /me/switch`. The token must be unused, less than 60 seconds old and issued for this tenant, to an active internal member of it. The tenant's policy applies: when it requires its identity provider, the browser goes to the sign-in page with `?error=auth.sso_required`; otherwise a session opens (cookies) and the browser goes to the application, which asks for a verification code when the account has two-step verification and the session left did not check it. Any other failure: the sign-in page with `?error=auth.switch_failed`.

303.description: Into the application, or to the sign-in page

404.description: `tenant.not_found`

get.summary: Browse one level of the hierarchy, with aggregates
get.description: Without `under`: the nodes at the top of what the member sees, that is without a parent, or without a parent they see (all root nodes for tenant admins). With `under`: the children of that node. Portfolios first, then programs and projects, each by name; archived nodes are left out. Every row carries the aggregate of its node over its distinct descendant projects. A confidential child the member has no access to comes veiled (`veiled: true`): its planned load, without name or detail.

parameters.name: under
parameters.description:
The node whose children are listed; without it, the top of the
hierarchy.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

get.summary: The signed-in account
get.description: The account and its role in the current tenant.

post.summary: Erase the signed-in account
post.description: Right to erasure: the account's name, email, password and preferences are removed, it leaves every tenant, and it appears as "Deleted user #N" everywhere, history included. Its content stays, unless `purgeComments`. Needs the password, or for an account without one, a sign-in through the organization's identity provider less than 10 minutes ago; and the email, typed. Ends every session.

204.description: Erased; the session's cookies are cleared

post.summary: Export the personal data of the signed-in account
post.description: Right of access: the account, its preferences and memberships in every tenant, and the content it authored, as JSON. Collected in the background: follow the export until it is `ready`, then download it, within 15 minutes.

get.summary: Follow an export of the signed-in account's personal data

404.description: No such export of this account, or expired

get.summary: Download an export of the signed-in account's personal data
get.description: A JSON file (`format`: `mlbpp.personal-data.v1`).

404.description: No such export of this account, or expired

get.summary: The tenants of the signed-in account
get.description: Active memberships of active tenants, by tenant name, with the account's role in each: the tenant switcher. In single-tenant mode, the current tenant only.

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in account
post.description: Needs the current password. Ends every other session of the account, in every tenant; this one stays open. Unusable by an account without a local password (SSO only).

204.description: Changed; the other sessions are ended

put.summary: Set the language and time zone of the signed-in account
put.description: Both apply in every tenant of the account. `null` (or absent) means the tenant's default.

get.summary: The open sessions of the signed-in account
get.description: In every tenant of the account: the current one first, then by latest activity.

delete.summary: End a session of the signed-in account
delete.description: The session is refused from its next request on. Not the session of this request: sign out instead.

404.description: No such session of this account

post.summary: Start switching to another tenant
post.description: Issues a one-time link to the target tenant, valid for 60 seconds. The browser navigates to it: the target applies its own policy and opens a new session there (its SSO, two-step verification). The current session stays open.

403.description: `forbidden`: an external account here or in the target, or `csrf.invalid`

404.description: `not_found`: not a tenant of the account

get.summary: List the portfolios, programs and projects
get.description: In creation order; follow `nextCursor` until it is `null`. The active nodes, or with `archived=true` the archived projects. Only the nodes the member sees: all of them for tenant admins; for the others, those where a role with `view` reaches them, directly, through a group, or inherited. A confidential node they have no access to, under a node they see, comes veiled (`veiled: true`): its type only, without name or detail.

parameters.name: ancestorOf
parameters.description: Only the ancestors of this node, at any depth.

parameters.name: descendantOf
parameters.description:
Only the descendants of this node, at any depth; a node reached by
several paths comes once.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: `true`: the archived projects, instead of the active nodes.

post.summary: Create a portfolio, program or project
post.description: At the root: tenant admins only. Under `parentId`: tenant admins, and the members who administer that node. The type must be allowed under the parent: a portfolio under a portfolio, a program under a portfolio or a program, a project under any node.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

409.description: `node.key_taken`, `node.archived` (the parent is an archived project), or `idempotency_key.in_flight`

get.summary: Read a portfolio, program or project

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag already held: 304 if still current

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

put.summary: Change a portfolio, program or project
put.description: Tenant admins, and the members who administer the node. The type and the key do not change; the owners are replaced by `ownerIds`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being replaced, or `*`

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

412.description: The node changed since this ETag

get.summary: List who has access to a node
get.description: Every grant that applies on the node: those made on it (`direct`), then those inherited from an ancestor (`origin`), by holder name. A grant made above a confidential node does not reach it; the origin of a grant inherited from a node the member does not see is `null`. Tenant admins, and the members with `manage_members` on the node.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

get.summary: Read the aggregate of a node
get.description: Planned load, consumed capacity, progress, open and late tickets over the distinct descendant projects of the node, confidential ones included and archived ones left out. Precomputed: it follows a change within seconds.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

put.summary: Archive a project, or restore it
put.description: Tenant admins, and the members who administer the project. An archived project is read-only: changing it, its links or its children answers `node.archived`. It leaves the active lists (`GET /nodes?archived=true` lists the archived projects) and the aggregates of its ancestors, and comes back to them when restored. Its sub-projects are archived first, and restored after it. Only projects are archived.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed, or `*`

400.description: `validation_failed`: `archived` `not_allowed` on a portfolio or a program

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

409.description: `node.active_children`: it still has active sub-projects; `node.parent_archived`: it is under an archived project

412.description: The node changed since this ETag

get.summary: List the children of a node
get.description: By name, each with the weighting of its link. A confidential child the member has no access to comes veiled (`veiled: true`): its type only, without name or detail. Deeper descendants: `GET /nodes?descendantOf=`.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

put.summary: Make a project confidential, or open it again
put.description: A confidential project blocks inherited access: only the roles granted on the project itself reach it, and they still apply below it. Those who see one of its parents find it veiled in the lists. Projects only. Tenant admins, and the members who administer the project; the latter must keep that role from a grant made on the project itself, so that they do not shut themselves out. Applies from the next request.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed, or `*`

400.description: `validation_failed`: `confidential` `not_allowed` on a portfolio or a program

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

409.description: `node.confidential_lockout`: the member would lose their own access; `node.archived`: an archived project is read-only

412.description: The node changed since this ETag

get.summary: Read the configuration of a project
get.description: Whoever sees the project.

404.description: No such project visible to the member, or a portfolio or program

put.summary: Move a project to another configuration
put.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins, on a project they see. It uses the published version of its new configuration at once.

404.description: No such project visible to the member, or a portfolio or program

get.summary: Search the members and groups a role can be granted to
get.description: The groups, then the active members of the tenant, whose name (or email) holds `search`, each by name. Tenant admins, and the members with `manage_members` on the node.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the name (or of a member's email), any case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
At most this many groups and this many members, from 1 to 50
(default 10).

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

get.summary: List the roles the member may grant on a node
get.description: Every role of the tenant for tenant admins; for the members with `manage_members` on the node, the roles within their own permissions there. From the narrowest default role to the newest.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

post.summary: Grant a role on a node to a member or a group
post.description: The role applies on the node and on its descendants, from the next request. Tenant admins, and the members with `manage_members` on the node, for roles within their own permissions there.

403.description: `permission.denied`: `manage_members` is missing on this node; `forbidden`: the role is beyond the member's own permissions; or `csrf.invalid`

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

409.description: `node.grant_exists`: already granted to them on this node

delete.summary: Revoke a role granted on a node
delete.description: Only a grant made on this node: an inherited one is revoked on its `origin`. Applies from the next request, on the node and its descendants. Tenant admins, and the members with `manage_members` on the node, for roles within their own permissions there.

403.description: `permission.denied`: `manage_members` is missing on this node; `forbidden`: the role is beyond the member's own permissions; or `csrf.invalid`

404.description: No such node in this tenant, not visible to the member, or no such grant on it

get.summary: List the signed-in member's permissions on a node
get.description: The union of the roles that reach them there: granted to them or to one of their groups, on the node or inherited from an ancestor. Tenant admins have every permission. In catalog order.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

get.summary: Search the nodes that might become a parent
get.description: Active nodes the member sees, other than the node, whose name or key holds `search`, by name. Each says why it cannot become the parent (`refusal`), or `null` when it can.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the name or key, any case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, from 1 to 50 (default 20).

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

get.summary: List the parents of a node
get.description: By name, each with the weighting of its link; only the parents the member sees.

404.description: No such node in this tenant, or not visible to the member

put.summary: Attach a node under a parent, or change the link's weighting
put.description: Tenant admins, and the members who administer both nodes. The node's type must be allowed under the parent, and the parent must not be one of its descendants. Putting an existing link again sets its weighting.

200.description: The link existed: its weighting is set

403.description: `forbidden`: may not link these nodes, or `csrf.invalid`

404.description: No such node or parent in this tenant, or not visible to the member

409.description: `node.parent_not_allowed` (attachment matrix), `node.cycle`, or `node.archived` (the node or the parent is an archived project)

delete.summary: Detach a node from one of its parents
delete.description: Tenant admins, and the members who administer both nodes. Without parents left, the node is at the root.

403.description: `forbidden`: may not unlink these nodes, or `csrf.invalid`

404.description: No such node, parent or link in this tenant, or not visible to the member

409.description: `node.archived`: the node or the parent is an archived project

get.summary: Check that the API answers

post.summary: Erase a global account
post.description: Platform super admins only. The account leaves every tenant and appears as "Deleted user #N" everywhere, its personal data removed; its content stays, unless `purgeComments`. Every session of the account ends.

403.description: `forbidden`: not a platform super admin, or `csrf.invalid`

404.description: No such account, or erased already

get.summary: List every tenant
get.description: Platform super admin only. In creation order; follow `nextCursor` until it is `null`.

post.summary: Create a tenant
post.description: Platform super admin only. The tenant is reachable at once, at its `url`. Replaying the same request with the same `Idempotency-Key` within 24 hours returns the first response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

get.summary: Read a tenant
get.description: Platform super admin only.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag already held: 304 if still current

404.description: No such tenant

put.summary: Change the settings and quotas of a tenant
put.description: Platform super admin only. The slug cannot change.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being replaced, or `*`

404.description: No such tenant, or it is being deleted

412.description: The tenant changed since this ETag

delete.summary: Delete a tenant and all its data
delete.description: Platform super admin only, confirmed by typing the tenant's slug in `confirm`. The tenant stops resolving at once; a background job then removes all its data, and the accounts that belonged to it only. The tenant of the request itself cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: The tenant's slug, typed by the super admin to confirm.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being deleted, or `*`

404.description: No such tenant, or already being deleted

412.description: The tenant changed since this ETag

get.summary: List the project configurations
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. In creation order, the default configuration first; follow `nextCursor` until it is `null`.

403.description: `forbidden`: neither a tenant admin nor a configuration admin

post.summary: Create a project configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. It starts with a published version 1, and no project.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

get.summary: Read a project configuration
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag already held: 304 if still current

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

put.summary: Rename a project configuration
put.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. The name applies at once: it is no content of the configuration, which goes through its draft.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the version being changed, or `*`

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

412.description: The configuration changed since this ETag

delete.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. Refused for the default configuration (`config.default`) and while projects use it (`config.in_use`).

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

412.description: The configuration changed since this ETag

post.summary: Open the draft of a project configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. The draft starts as a copy of the published version; its admins share it. If it is open already, it is returned as it is.

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

delete.summary: Discard the draft of a project configuration
delete.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. The published version stays as it is.

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

412.description: The configuration changed since this ETag

post.summary: Duplicate a project configuration, or detach a project from it
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. The copy starts from the published version of the original (its draft stays with it). With `projectId`, that project moves to the copy: further changes of the original no longer affect it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the configuration to copy

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

400.description: `validation_failed`; `projectId` `not_using` when the project uses another configuration

404.description: No such configuration, or no such project visible to the member

get.summary: List the issue types of a configuration
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. In their order; from the draft if the configuration has one (`stage: draft`), else from its published version.

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

post.summary: Add an issue type to the draft of a configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. It goes last, in the draft, opened if needed; the projects get it once the draft is published.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

put.summary: Order the issue types in the draft of a configuration
put.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. Every type once, in the new order; each type that moves counts as a change of the draft.

200.description: The types, in their new order

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

get.summary: Read an issue type
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. From the draft if the configuration has one, else from its published version.

404.description: No such configuration or type

put.summary: Change an issue type in the draft of a configuration
put.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. In the draft, opened if needed; its `key` stays. A type is never its own ancestor (`issue_type.cycle`).

404.description: No such configuration or type

412.description: The type changed since this ETag

delete.summary: Remove an issue type from the draft of a configuration
delete.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. From the draft, opened if needed, and from the parents of the other types. If tickets use it, publishing needs them moved to another type first (`needsMigration` of the publish impact).

404.description: No such configuration or type

412.description: The type changed since this ETag

get.summary: List the projects using a configuration
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. By name, archived projects included. A project the member does not see comes veiled (`veiled: true`).

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

post.summary: Publish the draft of a project configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. The draft becomes the published version of every project of the configuration at once; the former one is retired. Send the `version` of the publish impact the user confirmed as `If-Match`: if the configuration changed since, 412.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the configuration the impact was read on

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

409.description: `config.no_draft`, or `workflow.invalid`: each problem of the workflows of the draft in `errors`

412.description: The configuration changed since this ETag

get.summary: What publishing the draft of a configuration does
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. The projects that get the new version, to confirm before publishing, and whether their tickets must be migrated first. A project the member does not see comes veiled.

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

put.summary: Change a status in the draft of a configuration
put.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. Its `key` stays; made initial, it takes the place of the former initial status.

404.description: No such configuration or status

412.description: The status changed since this ETag

delete.summary: Remove a status from the draft of a configuration
delete.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. With the transitions from and to it. If tickets are in it, publishing needs them moved first (`needsMigration` of the publish impact).

404.description: No such configuration or status

412.description: The status changed since this ETag

put.summary: Change a transition in the draft of a configuration

404.description: No such configuration or transition

412.description: The transition changed since this ETag

delete.summary: Remove a transition from the draft of a configuration

404.description: No such configuration or transition

412.description: The transition changed since this ETag

get.summary: List the workflows of a configuration
get.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. In their order, with their statuses, transitions, the types that follow them and what keeps them from being published; from the draft if the configuration has one (`stage: draft`), else from its published version.

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

post.summary: Add a workflow to the draft of a configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. Empty, or with `copyOf` a copy of the statuses and transitions of another workflow; in the draft, opened if needed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

Location.description: URL of the workflows of the configuration

404.description: No such configuration in this tenant

put.summary: Rename a workflow in the draft of a configuration
put.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. Its `key` stays.

404.description: No such configuration or workflow

412.description: The workflow changed since this ETag

delete.summary: Remove a workflow from the draft of a configuration
delete.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. With its statuses and transitions; refused while issue types follow it (`workflow.in_use`) and for the last one (`workflow.last`).

404.description: No such configuration or workflow

412.description: The workflow changed since this ETag

post.summary: Add a status to a workflow in the draft of a configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. It goes last; made initial, it takes the place of the former initial status.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

201.description: The workflow, with its new status

Location.description: URL of the workflows of the configuration

404.description: No such configuration or workflow

post.summary: Add a transition to a workflow in the draft of a configuration
post.description: Tenant admins and configuration admins. From a status of the workflow, or from any (`fromId` null), to one of its statuses.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

201.description: The workflow, with its new transition

Location.description: URL of the workflows of the configuration

400.description: `validation_failed`; `fromId` or `toId` `not_found` (not a status of the workflow)

404.description: No such configuration or workflow

get.summary: List reference items
get.description: In creation order. Follow `nextCursor` until it is `null`.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to return for each item, e.g. `id,code`.

post.summary: Create a reference item
post.description: Replaying the same request with the same `Idempotency-Key` within 24 hours returns the first response (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without creating a duplicate.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `id,code`. Default: every field
but `labelTranslations`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key of this creation, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

get.summary: Read a reference item

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
